Markup-fidelity fixture for pa-heatmap — an activity grid (GitHub-contributions style) of intensity cells. Shape:
…
. Cells are DATA-DRIVEN from a `levels` list; each cell's intensity is a data-level="0..4" ATTRIBUTE (NOT a modifier class — the SCSS styles cells via .pa-heatmap__cell[data-level="N"]). `columns` sets the inline grid-template-columns (the base SCSS hardcodes repeat(53,…); the inline style overrides the column count). variant is success|danger ONLY — those are the two CSS-backed cell ramps (.pa-heatmap--success/.pa-heatmap--danger .pa-heatmap__cell[data-level]); there is no base/primary modifier (the default accent ramp emits no class). SCOPE: the pa-heatmap block only. The SEPARATE legend block (pa-heatmap__legend / pa-heatmap__legend-cell — keen heatmap_legend/1, svelte HeatmapLegend.svelte) is a different component and is deferred out of scope below.

propsVocabulary.levels: list of intensity levels (0-4); one pa-heatmap__cell is rendered per entry, carrying data-level={level}. Structural data — drives the cells, no class.
propsVocabulary.columns: number of grid columns — inline style grid-template-columns: repeat(N, 1.2rem). Structural, no class.
propsVocabulary.variant: cell-ramp colour variant (success|danger). The default accent ramp is the BASE and emits NO modifier class; there is no pa-heatmap--primary.

goldenConventions: Goldens encode the core snippet/demo shape (demo/views/data-visualization.mustache lines 442+). pa-heatmap is an inline-grid whose cells come from a data list; the per-cell intensity is a data-level ATTRIBUTE (0-4), not a class. The column count is a data-driven inline style (grid-template-columns: repeat(N, 1.2rem)) treated as a scenario-provided value so both wrappers receive the same N. variant success|danger emit pa-heatmap--{variant}; the default accent ramp emits no modifier. compact emits pa-heatmap--compact. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-heatmap(--|__)'). Block modifiers in CSS: pa-heatmap--success, pa-heatmap--danger, pa-heatmap--compact. Element classes: pa-heatmap__cell (claimed/exercised), pa-heatmap__legend + pa-heatmap__legend-cell (SEPARATE legend component — deferred out of scope; they are pa-heatmap__* so the reverse element check sees them, hence an explicit deferred bucket). `produces: null` = structural/native (no pa-heatmap modifier). variant EXCLUDES any base/primary — the default accent cell ramp is the base and has no modifier class. levels/columns are structural data (produces:null, kind:string so capability doesn't enum-check them).

columns.note: structural — inline style grid-template-columns: repeat(N, 1.2rem); no class

levels.note: structural data — one pa-heatmap__cell[data-level] per entry; no modifier class. kind:string so capability doesn't enum-check the list.

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

deferred.//: The legend is a SEPARATE block/component (keen heatmap_legend/1, svelte HeatmapLegend.svelte) that happens to use pa-heatmap__* element names, so the reverse element-class check sees pa-heatmap__legend / pa-heatmap__legend-cell. They are acknowledged out-of-scope for THIS fixture (prose deferral — advisory, not fixture-verified).

deferred.pa-heatmap__legend-cell: separate legend component (heatmap_legend/1 · HeatmapLegend.svelte) — out of scope for the grid fixture
